title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Aralab is a leading manufacturer of environmental chambers and is committed to make sure that our clients can simulate all kinds of environment from simulating the harshest North Pole climate to the hottest places on earth. We are a engineering-driven company and hundreds of renowned research institutions and multinational companies have partnered with us for the past 40 years.

Our equipment has all kinds of purposes, from helping Formula 1 teams delivering more reliable cars to fighting cancer and even solving mass food production problems through crop science.

Currently we are a team of highly motivated and committed 100 members based in Sintra and we are looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join this amazing team.

Want to fly through our factory?


Your Role

  • Create and unleash mechanical designs using CAD, CAM, and 3D CAD software to bring ideas to life;

  • Oversee project implementation, ensuring everything hits those design specs with precision;

  • Keep projects on track and crush deadlines to deliver milestones and final outputs;

  • Craft detailed technical reports, design specs, and operational manuals that'll guide the way;

  • Work hand-in-hand with the electrical and refrigeration systems teams to create seamless, integrated design solutions.


About You

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering;

  • At least 3 years of experience in mechanical design and development;

  • Proficient in using SolidWorks for both 3D and 2D design;

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills;

  • Detail-oriented with a professional attitude, reliability, and excellent communication skills;

  • Team player with a strong ability to collaborate effectively with others;

  • Proficient in English.


Why Aralab?

  • Performance-based bonuses;

  • Provided company phone and workstation;

  • Health insurance coverage from day one;

  • Engaging company-wide events and teambuilding activities.
